card.name: Spot just before a number or name
card.fires_on: Fires on the space or small piece just before an expected number, such as the gap after 'at least' before a duration. It also fires on the digit after '5.' in section cross-references.

modes.label: Gap before a duration
modes.description: The space after 'at least' or 'first' where a number of days or months comes next.
modes.example: for at least<< >>3 days afterwards may cause a disulf

modes.label: Section cross-reference digit
modes.description: The digit after '5.' or '8.' inside bracketed references to Warnings and Precautions or Specific Populations.
modes.example: [see Warnings and Precautions ( 5.<<1>> )]. WARNING: DEPRESSION AND SU

modes.label: Scattered name endings
modes.description: The last piece of a name or phrase, such as an organization acronym or a copyright line.
modes.example: National Institute of Neurological Disorders and Stroke (NIND<<S>>) NINDS offers

card.writes: The promoted tokens are unrelated and unclear, so there is no clear output effect.
card.plain: It marks the spot where a number, such as a duration or section number, is about to appear.
